# Copilot Instructions

## Project
Lead Generation Widget — an embeddable frontend widget for capturing and qualifying leads.
Week 2 focus: a settings form with validation, as a precursor feature.

## Stack
- React + TypeScript
- Form validation: React Hook Form + Zod (adjust once decided)
- Package manager: npm

## Conventions
- Functional components only, no class components
- TypeScript strict mode — avoid `any`
- Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:, docs:, etc.)
- Prefer small, focused components over large ones
- Co-locate component styles/tests with the component file

## Code Style
- 2-space indentation
- Prefer named exports over default exports
- Validation logic should be separated from UI rendering where practical
